purpose: Teach: 敬愛/則っ/基い/準じ/使途/呼び掛け/打ち込み/ベルク

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、創業者を敬愛する社風を保て
lines.en: Maintain our company culture of respect for the founder.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative. Even pace. Speaks like someone accustomed to being listened to. A principle stated, not questioned.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員規程に則って動きます
lines.en: Understood. I'll ensure the team operates within personnel regulations.
lines.style: Deferential but assured. Nod in the voice. Calm confirmation. Not obsequious — professional respect between colleagues.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、過去のデータに基いた意思決定をしろ
lines.en: Make decisions grounded in our past data and performance.
lines.style: Steady, firm. Each phrase lands deliberately. Speaks without inflection — not cold, just practiced in command. Slight pause before the verb.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界基準に準じて運用します
lines.en: Understood. We'll operate in line with industry standards.
lines.style: Earnest acknowledgment. Slightly quicker pace than Hiroshi — eager to show he's already thinking ahead. Respectful but not stiff.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 予算の使途を明確にしろ
lines.en: Make budget expenditures transparent and accountable.
lines.style: Brief, non-negotiable. Clipped tone. The economy of someone who doesn't repeat himself. Slight weight on 'transparent'.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員への呼び掛けも丁寧にします
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure communications to staff are handled with care.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Slight lean into the response — showing he understands the principle behind the directive. Thoughtful, not rushed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新製品開発に打ち込み続けろ
lines.en: Keep driving new product development. Don't slow down.
lines.style: Purposeful intensity. Weight on 'keep driving.' Forward momentum in the delivery. A challenge wrapped in professional expectation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ドイツのベルク市と姉妹都市契約を検討します
lines.en: Understood. I'm exploring a sister-city partnership with Berg, Germany.
lines.style: Forward-looking, concrete. Slight lift — he's already moving. Shows initiative within the framework of what he's just heard. Confident close.
